description: Election Commission - Declare that Mr. D. G. M. Kumara as a member of the Nuwaraeliya Municiyal Council
categorisation: This gazette content specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in a municipal council under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves electoral processes at the local government level, including the resignation of a council member, nomination by a political party, and the formal declaration of a new council member by the Returning Officer. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) which cover electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations related to local authority elections.
